verdict.rationale: Pipecat bots are plain code files that stay portable across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud, and self-hosting, so they can be kept in ordinary source control (implied, not documented). Pipecat Evals re-runs expected conversations against the real agent to check whether behavior still holds, which supports reviewing changes. Neither covers built-in versioning or rollback; missing for 10: documented versioning of bots/flows or Cloud deployments, a rollback mechanism for deployed agents, a change-review/diff workflow, and independent corroboration.
